Newsletter March 2024

Dear members,

We from the 7th board Have started looking for next board of our association. Would you be interested in being the board of the best association of the UT? Are you already certain to apply or still have some questions or doubts, do not worry. To make sure everyone can make a well informed decision, we as board will host a Board interest drink where we will go over all information that you might need. Food will be provided by us during the event. The drink will take place at the Predator Esports Lounge Tomorrow on the 6th of march and will start at 18:00. 

Signup link https://forms.gle/eT2UbiHSGH1PAQF5A

 

Hope to see you there, 
The 7th board.

 

 

TABLE OF CONTENTS

  • Half year GMM announcement
  • This was Februari
  • What is coming up in March

Half year GMM

Dear members of Blueshell.

On tuesday the 6th of February 19:00, we had our half year GMM. We would like to thank everyone who came and shared their input with us. For those of you who happened to miss it, you will be able to find the minutes in your mail somewhere next week :).

 

Max Jansdam

Secretary of Blueshell

Upcoming in March

The Weekly gamenights organised by the board continue! Be sure to come by the lounge and have a drink (They might not all be listed below, but are every monday). 

Committee events are happening. Be sure to check them out

 
­

Esports

The Promotions are done and the second split already started! We Have some new teams this split, be sure to give them a warm welcome <3

 

Rocket League

Blueshell Turtles 

The Turtles are back and ready for a new season of ballin... hitting balls with cars... And winning ofcourse!

BS Oogway

After their succes in the previous split, Oogway became the only Blueshell team to continue into main DSL. Here they might have lost their first 2 games, but they have high hopes for their upcoming game. So lets wish them the best!

BS Squirtles

THEY WON their demotion tourney and will not be demoting! Lets see how well they will do next season.

BS Tadpoles

Tadpoles Died :( 

 

League of Legends 

BS Scaling

They Scaling is back this this split in a higher devision! Here they have tied their first game, but as their name implies they will be bringing it back in the lategame!

BS Happy Hour

A completely new Blueshell league of legends team filled with fist year members and Mark from BS housecats has entered DCLS this split. They will be facing BS Scaling and my old team in division 3. So come and wish them a lot of luck and succes! They also tied their first game.

BS Housecats

They died 

 

Valorant

Bs Tempra

They are back for a new season of DCVS. Wish them the best!

SpicyWater and IcyWater

They died. But from their ashes rose 2 new teams!

IcySpicy

The first team that came out of the Waters is IcySpicy and they will have a good season to look forward to as some of the best Icywater and Spicywater players will be playing for them

WaterBoarders

The second team is your board! The whole 7th board of Blueshell has become one amazing Valorant team. 

 

CS2

HyperS

HyperS ended their last split with a bang! In their promotion tourney they managed to win all their games and demolish ETT in the progress. Now it will be time to see what they will show us in the upcoming season of DCCS :)
